pages.text: A construct body is a transient mathematical object made from a bounded region and an exact block material.$(br2)It is not a placed structure and it is not a persistent entity. The server owns its material, motion, collision, and lifetime.

pages.title: The Cavalieri chain
pages.text: $(li)solid_of_revolution(Vec3, Vec3) -> Region$(li)materialize_construct(Region) -> Construct Body$(li)compress_construct(Body, Number) -> Construct Body$(li)spin_construct(Body, Vec3, Number) -> Construct Body$(li)launch_construct(Body, Vec3, Vec3) -> Effect$(br2)The Cavalieri Projectile is this chain saved as a theorem, not a hidden mega-rune.

pages.title: Material is a parameter
pages.text: The first preset names minecraft:stone explicitly. Custom programs may replace the material constant with an exact block item id.$(br2)The block must be an ordinary BlockItem. Fluids, block entities, tags, NBT variants, and placement callbacks are outside this slice.

pages.title: Cost and mass
pages.text: The candidate voxels determine the maximum item count and the mass-equivalent of the body. Compression changes visual scale but does not create or destroy source items.$(br2)The work proxies are: linear = 0.5 * m * |v|^2; rotational = 0.5 * I * omega^2; compression surcharge = m * (1 / scale^3 - 1). They are balance measures, not SI units.

pages.title: Boundaries
pages.text: The preview is an upper bound. A cast may use fewer voxels, but never more than 128. Scale is clamped to 0.25..1, angular speed to pi/4, launch speed to 2, and flight lifetime to 100 ticks.$(br2)The body emits particles as its first visual presentation.

pages.title: When a launch fails
pages.text: No exact material means no cast. An unloaded chunk, a block collision, an invalid state, or the owner's existing flight ends the transient body without changing terrain.$(br2)Survival-ready protection and dedicated-server GameTests are still part of the next P8 hardening pass.
